LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.0.label: ate guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.0.descri: I swallowed some guanyin clay. There is something in my stomach, but I still want a proper meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.1.label: ate more guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.1.descri: I swallowed another lump of clay, and my stomach feels uncomfortably full. This is not what I want to eat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.2.label: enough guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.2.descri: I have eaten several lumps of clay. I can still taste the dirt. Please, no more of this.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.0.label: still hungry
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.0.descr: I am hungry. My stomach aches for food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.1.label: plea for food went unanswered
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.1.descr: I am hungry. I asked for food, but never got a bite.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineFed.stages.0.label: finally full
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineFed.stages.0.descript: That meal filled me up. At last, I can stop thinking about my empty stomach.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Sheltered.stages.0.label: taken in, squeak! so happy!
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Sheltered.stages.0.descript: They let me stay, squeak! At last, I have somewhere to go.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Captured.stages.0.label: locked in a cage, squeak...
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Captured.stages.0.descripti: They locked me up, squeak... I want to get out.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_EnslavedFed.stages.0.label: there's food, squeak...
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_EnslavedFed.stages.0.descri: I have to work for my master now... But there's food here. At least I won't go hungry, squeak.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_EnslavedServing.stages.0.de: Now I have to obey my master and work for them, squeak... I don't want to be ordered around.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Expelled.stages.0.label: chased away
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Expelled.stages.0.descripti: They chased me away, squeak... Where else can I go?
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Expelled.stages.1.label: I want food, squeak!
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_Expelled.stages.1.descripti: How dare they chase me away! I want food, squeak! I still need something to eat!
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteFood.stages.0.label: something to eat, squeak
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteFood.stages.0.descriptio: There's food in my belly, squeak. That feels good.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteFood.stages.1.label: yummy, squeak squeak!
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_AteFood.stages.1.descriptio: That was a good bite, squeak! I want another.
